basis: Treponemal infection with defining cutaneous and mucocutaneous inflammatory lesions; no additional organ has established common direct damage.

decisions.dermatologic: primary: defining cutaneous lesions reflect direct treponemal infection and dermal inflammation, establishing skin as a disease site.

basis: Complex I metabolic defect; basal ganglia necrosis 3/3 and developmental regression 4/4 establish neurologic injury. Weakness alone does not establish intrinsic myopathy.

decisions.neurologic: involved: basal ganglia necrosis 3/3 and regression 4/4 demonstrate common direct brain injury from the defining mitochondrial metabolic defect.

basis: BBS1 spectrum includes retinal dystrophy, obesity and polydactyly; renal dysplasia is a major BBS criterion. Learning impairment (~30-60%) omitted at the four-axis cap.

decisions.renal: involved: renal dysplasia/dysfunction is a major Bardet-Biedl diagnostic criterion, despite lower renal penetrance in BBS1.
decisions.neurologic: none: common learning impairment (~30-60%) qualifies but is omitted at the four-axis cap, retaining the defining features and potentially severe renal disease.
decisions.musculoskeletal: primary: postaxial polydactyly is a defining skeletal malformation and major diagnostic criterion of the predominant Bardet-Biedl phenotype.

basis: Manganese transport defect with dystonia 14/15 and defining polycythemia (30-79%); cirrhosis 5/6 is retained as involved because primary is capped at three.

decisions.haematologic: primary: polycythemia is a named, defining blood-cell disorder, reported in 30-79%; the haematologic mechanism axis therefore applies.
decisions.hepatic: involved: direct manganese-related hepatic injury includes cirrhosis in 5/6; the three-primary cap retains the metabolic, neurologic and blood-cell axes.

basis: Characteristic neurodevelopmental impairment; radioulnar synostosis, finger contractures and strabismus each occur in 30-79%. Cardiac defects and delayed puberty occur in 5-29%.

decisions.musculoskeletal: involved: associated structural skeletal abnormalities, including radioulnar synostosis and finger contractures, occur in 30-79%.

basis: Cardiomyopathy/arrhythmia, encephalopathy/developmental impairment and rhabdomyolysis each occur in 80-99%; common hepatic biochemical injury is omitted at the four-axis cap.

decisions.hepatic: none: hepatic biochemical injury occurs in 80-99%, but failure is 5-29%; omitted at the cap in favor of common severe cardiac, brain and muscle injury.
decisions.musculoskeletal: involved: rhabdomyolysis occurs in 80-99%, establishing frequent direct skeletal-muscle injury and supporting retention under the cap.

basis: Mucosal-site tumor umbrella including reproductive sites; no shared covered organ is established. Myogenic differentiation alone does not establish skeletal-muscle origin.

decisions.musculoskeletal: none: the definition locates this tumor in mucosal organs, not skeletal muscle; rhabdomyoblastic differentiation alone does not establish a musculoskeletal site.

basis: IL17RC immunodeficiency causes chronic candidiasis of skin, nails and oral mucosa, which are defining sites; Candida esophagitis is reported in 1/3.

decisions.gastrointestinal: primary: oral mucosa is a defining site of chronic mucocutaneous candidiasis; esophageal candidiasis is additionally documented in 1/3.

basis: Defining diaphragm, bowel and splenic defects; pulmonary hypoplasia is common (>30%) with congenital diaphragmatic hernia, although syndrome-specific frequency is unknown.

decisions.pulmonary: involved: congenital diaphragmatic hernia commonly (>30%) directly impairs lung development, causing pulmonary hypoplasia; syndrome-specific frequency is unavailable.

basis: Developmental impairment and immunodeficiency; skeletal dysplasia/contractures and hypogonadism each 30-79%. Panniculitis (30-79%) omitted at cap; ocular disease 5-29%.

decisions.dermatologic: none: panniculitis occurs in 30-79% but is omitted at the four-axis cap, prioritizing persistent skeletal abnormalities and gonadal endocrine dysfunction.
decisions.metabolic_endocrine: involved: hypogonadism occurs in 30-79% and represents direct loss of gonadal endocrine function.
